# Danilo Cappelletti – Software Developer

> Software Developer based in Pisa, Italy, with 6+ years of experience building enterprise web applications with React.js, Vue.js and Node.js, plus specialist Python tools for papyrus reconstruction. Portfolio site: https://danilocappelletti.github.io/personalPortfolio/

Language: English (default) with an Italian version available on the site (toggle "IT" in the navbar).

## Work experience
- Software Developer, Stetel Srl (Livorno, Italy), November 2025 – June 2026: Vue.js web applications, modular JavaScript, Docker-based development environments, REST API integration, agile team.
- Software Developer, Apparound SpA (Pisa, Italy), September 2022 – September 2025: enterprise full-stack applications with React.js and Node.js, REST API design and integration, cross-functional technical coordination.
- Web Developer, Unikey Corporation (Pisa, Italy), September 2020 – September 2022: WordPress websites, performance optimisation with HTML, CSS and Vanilla JavaScript, responsive React.js interfaces.
- Web Developer, JC Management (Dubai, UAE, remote), May 2021 – August 2022: reusable React.js front-end components and responsive, pixel-precise implementations for a Dubai-based client.

## Projects
- TIFF Image Editor (papyrus reconstruction tool): sole developer of a Python desktop application (Pillow, Tkinter, PyInstaller) for arranging and stitching very large scans, with precision measurement tools. Received the EU Seal of Excellence; not funded. Browser demo: https://danilocappelletti.github.io/personalPortfolio/tiff-demo.html
- Sensor Monitor (test project, not a production application): Vue 3 and TypeScript dashboard built to practise IoT-style monitoring, with charts (Chart.js), analytics and responsive tables (Tailwind). Browser demo with sample data: https://danilocappelletti.github.io/personalPortfolio/sensor-demo.html
- GymBuddy: personal full-stack booking platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL and Stripe, with credit systems, instructor management and reporting. Source: https://github.com/danilocappelletti/GymBuddy

- Tools and platforms: Docker, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Stripe, REST APIs, WordPress, PyInstaller
